title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding — full Companion and physics paper
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v5.0.0 introduces a database-backed organization of statements, definitions, dependencies, guards and ordered document editions. The release comprises two complementary documents from one source snapshot: the full Companion, retaining the broader programme and its research history, and the English physics paper Graded carriers and physical readouts: conditions for mass and geometric interpretation.

The physics paper studies the conditions needed to transfer a graded carrier to particle, mass and geometric readouts. It separates the exact projection identity from generation embeddings, positive principal-root laws, state selection and autonomous projected dynamics. Conditional Koide/HC comparisons, rank and positivity obstructions, a gapped mass comparison and finite geometric compatibility are presented with their hypotheses. An electromagnetic interval example explains the QAM assertion language, MML instructions and bounded MMA execution semantics. A zeta/parity comparison at sigma greater than one illustrates compatibility with uncertainty, without supplying a physical mass mechanism.

Scope: this is a conditional mathematical-physics research programme, not a completed unified theory. No native lepton spectrum, absolute physical mass scale, general gravitational field equations or closure of the open problems is established by this release. Historical qualified or withdrawn routes remain identified as such in the full Companion. Database registration, hashes, execution receipts and provenance checks do not constitute proof of physical interpretation. The manuscript has undergone documented self-review, not independent peer review.

The closing research question asks whether three coupled strings can relax at different rates under expansion while a fixed outer length constrains their total length. A dissipative comparison separates changing rest lengths, tensile forces and energy accounting. The proposed link to a de Sitter length is an additional assumption: no cosmological constant, lepton spectrum or selected Koide ratio is derived. The question is retained as open research.

The package contains two English PDFs, compilable sources, a database snapshot and checksum manifests. Both document editions retain open argument-review obligations.

Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24152615. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19210728.
notes: Two complementary English documents in one versioned Companion record. The version DOI identifies the whole package. The German reader edition is excluded. Scientific guards and incomplete argument-review flags remain unchanged. Reservation and upload do not constitute publication.
